verdict.rationale: Ironclad's documented REST API can launch workflows from templates, which drafts the contract. The platform then takes the contract through its approval and signature policies, and integrations can push approvals forward. Ironclad Signature can be embedded, signed agreements can be collected via the API, and webhooks report status, so an agent could drive an NDA end-to-end through the API. It needs setup first: an admin must publish the workflow in Workflow Designer, and the API add-on must be enabled. Missing for 10: any official MCP server or agent-specific tooling, an NDA-specific end-to-end example, a published OpenAPI spec (probe returned 404), and independent hands-on corroboration.
